# SRS Mahal & SGS Mini Hall

> An architect-designed hall on 6 grounds with 65% landscaped open space — for 700 seated, with a 250-seat mini hall and 10 A/C rooms.

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can SRS Mahal & SGS Mini Hall hold?
SRS Mahal seats 700 (floating 900); SGS Mini Hall seats 250 (floating 400); the dining hall seats 150. All fully air-conditioned.

### Where is SRS Mahal & SGS Mini Hall?
#01, Karanaipuduchery Main Road, Karanaipuduchery, Urapakkam 603202.

### What facilities does SRS Mahal & SGS Mini Hall have?
Centralised A/C, SGS Mini Hall, Dining hall for 150, 10 A/C rooms, Lift, Ganesh temple on premises, Steam-cooking kitchen, Granite & marble flooring, Ample car parking, Parking for 100 bikes, Full CCTV, 24-hour security, 24-hour generator, Landscaped grounds.

### Is non-vegetarian food allowed?
No, only vegetarian food.

### How far is it from GST Road?
400 metres from the Tea Kadai bus stop on GST Road, and 2 km from Urapakkam railway station.

### How do I check if SRS Mahal & SGS Mini Hall is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98404 27455.
